points.name: health.breath.session.action_data
points.interpretation: C62BFCC dispatches end, restart and title actions by event user data.

evidence: App 4 registers three page descriptors. Main mode creation registers the common action callback and sets localized text and image resources. The session creates a view with a screen builder that registers stop and restart to one callback with distinct user data; the callback executes separate end and restart branches. The information page stores and clears its root.
scope: Recorded shared UI calls only; no claim of all calls, sensor logic or training algorithm coverage. The common event data reader may handle several actions as described.
limitations: Changing callback pointers or event data can break training and page cleanup; mode index is used to address an array. Source objects and text must remain valid. Root slots are not thread barriers. Device behavior and recovery have not been validated.
